Quantity glyph stability masks are derived from [Maple Classic Exp Overlay](https://github.com/beanguri/Maple-Classic-Exp-Overlay), assets/potion_digits.npz, under the included MIT license. Only its invariant-pixel support masks are adapted; the grayscale examples come from our manually transcribed HUD crops. The source asset hash and native masks are recorded in tools/quickslot-invariant-masks.json. Reproduce them with tools/build-quickslot-invariant-masks.py and that source NPZ file. No external recognition service is used.
